'''Frun''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Behind the scenes==
Frun first appeared in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', but he is one of several NPCs on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] whose questlines were cut from the final version. Frun would have introduced the mission "Awkward Conversations," where he requests that the player deliver a report from the [[Dark Council]] to Apprentice [[Maraad]]. Frun is unable to do so himself because his master is currently engaged in a [[Kaggath]] with Maraad's master, [[Shalath]], and after the message is delivered Maraad reveals that it is an execution order for most of Lord Shalath's family.
